note: Small recreation area on the Mississippi east of Muscatine, between the river and Highway 22 and the railroad. Two boat ramps with courtesy docks (pulled in mid to late November); towboat watching. Water and the modern restrooms are off from mid-October to late April; electricity stays on until the campground closes. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20/$24 electric, 42 sites (+ host H43), 20/30/50A, showers, dump, 100% reservable. Filled water hookups at 41 sites, 26-50 ft back-ins. Waterfront lead: riverfront -> riverview (the boat-ramp parking lot, its access road and a tree strip lie between the south row and the river; RA photos show the river across them). Season conflict: DNR alert says it closes Nov 1. Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (downgrade lead): stored riverfront -> riverview. On NAIP the campground's south row is ~55 m from the Mississippi, with a tree strip, the paved boat-trailer parking lot and the ramp access road between the pads and the bank, and the campground's own loop road in front. Day use and a driveway in the way rule out on-water. The view is earned: the DNR page says 'Campers will enjoy river views from their campsites', and RA photos of sites 010, 020, 025 and 040 show the river past the lot. The north row backs onto the railroad and Highway 22.

SEASON: the DNR alert (posted 10/15/2026) says 'Electricity in the Campground will remain on until November 1, when the Campground closes for the season.' The stored manual season closes 11-15 (from RA 'closed each year from November 16 - March 31'). The alert may be this year only; not changed.
SITES: H43 is a host site and not counted; count stays 42. Sites 002 (26 ft), 011 and 019 (30 ft) are the short ones; everything else is 32 ft or longer.
DNR page error: the 'Fairport State Recreation Area campground map' link (media/6644) serves the Fort Defiance State Park campground map.
